Trees and prices

Bolton collection costs exclude VAT. Sell/tree is your delivered price.

Total trees in plan100
Offer / supplier sizeGrade usedQtyCollect/treeWe Tree KingsSell/tree

The foot band is the offer label; the centimetre band is the supplier's quoted size. Norway and Noble foot labels follow your chosen mapping, not an exact unit conversion. Premium uses the supplier's Premium quote for that centimetre band where one exists; otherwise the non-premium quote stays in use. With Premium off, Standard is used first, then Regular or Value; Premium is used when it is the only quote. You can edit a collection cost; switching Premium refreshes all supplier costs. We Tree Kings prices follow the offer foot band and were checked 22 September 2026. Changing the percentage below their price replaces manual edits to matched prices. Blank comparisons need a selling price before adding stock.

Cinco stands

Enter stands sold; the calculator assumes you purchase exactly that many.

StandSoldSupplier, ex VATSell/stand

Cinco 6 fits trees up to 6 ft; Cinco 8 up to 8 ft; Cinco 10 up to 10 ft. Supplier quotes exclude VAT. Selling prices are VAT-inclusive when registered. Stands are assumed to travel with tree deliveries, so they add no separate van days or leaflets.

Sales assumptions

0–100%100.0%

Self-delivery route

Delivery days follow trees sold. Miles also include supplier collection trips.

Collection and delivery are budgeted as separate van days. The 30-tree load is a planning assumption for netted 6–7 ft trees; reduce it for taller or bulkier stock. Check both van payload and internal length with the hire firm. Enter the actual supplier-to-depot return mileage; it starts at zero because your collection route is not known.

Van, labour and other costs

Assumes each converted leaflet customer buys one tree and all planned sales come from leaflets. Printing is rounded up to whole batches. Disposal uses one all-in trip per full or partial van load of unsold trees; it adds no separate hire, driver or fuel charge.
